description: This file defines the Express.js routes for managing flashcards in the backend. It sets up route handlers for CRUD operations including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting flashcards. The routes incorporate middleware for authentication, authorization, validation, and documentation via Swagger annotations.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list or search flashcards, with authentication and validation middleware.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single flashcard by ID, with authentication and validation middleware.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new flashcard, requiring admin authorization and validation.

methods.name: router.put
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing flashcard by ID, requiring admin authorization and validation.

methods.name: router.delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a flashcard by ID, requiring admin authorization and validation.
